title: Group and longitudinal intra-individual networks of eating disorder symptoms in adolescents and young adults at-risk for an eating disorder
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size for individual networks (n=50); - Data collected retrospectively with potential recall bias; - Time lag of four weeks may not capture rapid symptom dynamics; - Cannot make causal claims due to non-experimental design; - Models may be less accurate with low symptom endorsement.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. However, the authors mention that they used a random selection of 50 individuals from a larger dataset, which is a common practice in network analysis to ensure sufficient data for individual models. The code and data are available in the supplementary materials.
